SUBZERO

一段在結冰雪地探索的第一人稱科幻短片。
記錄它的鏡頭敘事、場景製作與眨眼特效作法。A first-person sci-fi short set in a frozen wasteland.

SEC.01作品介紹THE FILM

故事大綱Synopsis

在一片覆雪的廢墟中，一道意識緩緩睜開雙眼——影片刻意不交代她是誰，也不確定「她」是否是人類。鏡頭向右掃過殘破的建築群，帶出第一步的探索。隨著視角轉動，一艘墜毀的太空船出現，角色放慢腳步、小心靠近。地面上的焦黑刮痕，是墜落留下的痕跡。穿過殘骸後，建築物輪廓浮現，二樓外牆有一顆橘紅色球體。角色在牆外停了一會兒，接著一抬頭，那個不明物體已經在眼前——隨即後退、倒下，畫面失焦，影片在沒有給出答案的狀態下結束。

Amid a snow-covered ruin, a consciousness opens its eyes — the film never states who she is, or whether "she" is human at all. The camera pans right across broken buildings, leading into the first steps of exploration. As the view turns, a crashed spaceship appears; the character slows and approaches carefully. Scorched gouges on the ground mark where it fell. Past the wreckage a building emerges, with an orange-red sphere on its second-floor wall. The character pauses outside the wall, then looks up — the unknown object is already right there. A recoil, a fall, the image blurs, and the film ends without an answer.

SEC.03製作細節PRODUCTION DETAILS

三個自己加的處理Three things added by hand

DECAL
撞擊痕跡貼花Impact Decals

Decal（貼花）能直接投影貼合在場景表面，不用重新建模就能疊加痕跡與汙漬。這裡用它在雪地與船體周圍加上墜毀的焦黑刮痕，讓墜落這件事不靠文字就能被看出來。

A decal projects directly onto surfaces, adding marks and grime without remodeling. Here it places scorched gouges around the crash site, so the crash reads without any text.

VERTEX PAINT
雪地頂點繪製Snow Vertex Paint

用 Mesh Paint 模式，以頂點顏色（紅色通道）在同一塊地面上手刷兩種雪地材質的混合範圍，做出被擾動、踩踏過的雪地，避免大面積純色雪地的平板感。

In Mesh Paint mode, vertex colour (the red channel) hand-blends two snow materials over one ground plane, creating disturbed, trodden patches and breaking up a flat uniform snowfield.

KEYFRAME
手動加的鏡頭晃動Hand-keyed Camera Shake

移動鏡頭沒有用單純的線性平滑運動。在 Sequencer 的位移與旋轉軌道上多加了密集、不規則的關鍵幀，模擬走路時的上下晃動，讓第一人稱視角更有代入感。

The moving shots aren't smooth linear glides. Dense, irregular keyframes were added on the location and rotation tracks in Sequencer to mimic the bob of walking, making the POV feel more grounded.

SEC.04核心教學 · 第一人稱眨眼特效CORE TUTORIAL · BLINK EFFECT

第一人稱眨眼特效製作Making the first-person blink

這個眨眼效果用後處理材質在 2D 畫面上遮蔽視野，不需要 3D 眼皮模型，效能成本很低。因為本作是電影分鏡（CineCameraActor + Level Sequence）而不是可操作遊戲，所以不需要寫藍圖的 Timer 與 Timeline，直接在時間軸上 K 出眨眼曲線。核心是四個步驟。

The blink uses a post-process material to mask vision on the 2D screen — no 3D eyelid mesh, very low cost. Because this is a cinematic (CineCameraActor + Level Sequence), not a playable game, it skips Blueprint timers and timelines and keys the blink curve straight onto the timeline. Four steps at the core.

資料流向：時間軸數值 → 全域參數 → 後處理材質 → 相機畫面Data flow: timeline value → global parameter → material → camera view
01MPC
建立材質參數集 MPC_BlinkCreate the parameter collection MPC_Blink

在 Content Browser 右鍵 → Materials → Material Parameter Collection，命名 MPC_Blink。在 Scalar Parameters（純量參數）新增兩個變數：AmountOpened（眼睛張開幅度，預設 1.0）與 EyeHardness（遮罩邊緣硬度，預設 0.0）。

Right-click in the Content Browser → Materials → Material Parameter Collection, name it MPC_Blink. Under Scalar Parameters, add two values: AmountOpened (how open the eye is, default 1.0) and EyeHardness (mask-edge softness, default 0.0).

用途WhyMPC 是全場景共用的參數容器，任何材質、任何時間軸都能讀寫它。之後只要改 AmountOpened 一個數字，畫面就會即時跟著變——用一個值控制整個效果。An MPC is a global parameter container any material or timeline can read and write. Later, changing the single value AmountOpened updates the screen in real time — one value drives the whole effect.
02MAT
設定後處理材質 M_BlinkBuild the post-process material M_Blink

新建材質 M_Blink，將 Material Domain 改為 Post Process。流程：用 SceneTexture(PostProcessInput0) 抓取畫面；用 ScreenPosition 取得螢幕座標，把 Y 軸乘上 AmountOpened 做擠壓；組合座標後送進 SphereMask 產生圓形視野遮罩；最後把原始畫面 × 遮罩（Multiply）接到 Emissive Color。

Create a material M_Blink and set Material Domain to Post Process. The flow: grab the frame with SceneTexture(PostProcessInput0); read screen coords with ScreenPosition, multiply the Y axis by AmountOpened to squeeze it; feed the combined coords into SphereMask for a round vision mask; finally send scene × mask (Multiply) to Emissive Color.

為什麼用乘法Why multiplySphereMask 遮罩內是 1、外是 0、邊緣介於兩者之間。原畫面乘上它：遮罩內保留正常畫面、遮罩外變黑、邊緣自然形成羽化漸層，這就是閉眼時柔和變暗的效果。The SphereMask is 1 inside, 0 outside, with a gradient at the edge. Multiplying the scene by it keeps the centre normal, turns the outside black, and feathers the rim — the soft darkening of a closing eye.
實際的 M_Blink 節點。最右側 Multiply 把場景畫面與 SphereMask 相乘後輸出。圖中多出的 EyeRoundess 是進階參數（見下方）。
The real M_Blink graph. The rightmost Multiply combines the scene with the SphereMask before output. The extra EyeRoundess here is an advanced parameter (see below).
進階補充 · EyeRoundessAdvanced · EyeRoundess

本作另外加了第三個純量參數 EyeRoundess，把圓形遮罩壓成橢圓，更接近真實眼睛的形狀。初學者可先略過，掌握四步後再加。

This project added a third scalar, EyeRoundess, to squash the round mask into an ellipse — closer to a real eye. Beginners can skip it and add it later.

03CAM
把材質掛到 CineCameraActorAttach the material to the CineCameraActor

在場景（或 Sequencer 軌道）選中 CineCameraActor。Details 面板找到 Post Process Settings → Rendering Features → Post Process Materials，點 + 新增陣列元素，把選單從 Weighted Blendables 改為 Asset Reference，再把 M_Blink 拖進去。

Select the CineCameraActor in the scene (or its Sequencer track). In Details find Post Process Settings → Rendering Features → Post Process Materials, click + to add an array element, switch the dropdown from Weighted Blendables to Asset Reference, then drop in M_Blink.

注意Note後處理材質是綁在攝影機上的。因為本作是電影鏡頭而不是第一人稱角色，所以掛在 CineCameraActor，而不是 BP_FirstPersonCharacter 的相機組件——這是原教學沒提、為了電影製作流程做的調整。A post-process material binds to a camera. Since this is a cinematic shot rather than a playable first-person pawn, it goes on the CineCameraActor instead of a character's camera component — an adaptation the original tutorial doesn't cover.
04SEQ
在 Sequencer K 出眨眼曲線Key the blink curve in Sequencer

打開 Level Sequence，點 +Track → Material Parameter Collection Track，指定 MPC_Blink，再點軌道的 +Parameter 勾選 AmountOpened。在這條軌道上 K 三個關鍵幀組成 U 型：1.0 睜開 → 0.0 閉合 → 1.0 睜開。框選三幀設為 Auto，生硬的折線就會變成平滑的 U 型曲線。

Open the Level Sequence, click +Track → Material Parameter Collection Track, pick MPC_Blink, then hit the track's +Parameter and tick AmountOpened. Key three frames into a U-shape: 1.0 open → 0.0 shut → 1.0 open. Select all three and set them to Auto; the sharp corners smooth into a U-curve.

為什麼設 AutoWhy Auto真實的眨眼不是等速開合，而是有加速與減速。Auto（Cubic）內插讓閉眼到睜眼的過渡平滑對稱，避免機械式的生硬感。這一步決定眨眼看起來自不自然。A real blink isn't linear — it eases in and out. Auto (Cubic) interpolation makes the shut-to-open transition smooth and symmetric, avoiding a mechanical look. This step decides whether the blink looks natural.
常見錯誤 · 黑邊沒有羽化感Common issue · Hard black edge, no feathering
症狀：閉眼時黑邊完全銳利，沒有柔和過渡。
Symptom: the black edge is razor-sharp on close, with no soft transition.
多半是把 AmountOpened / EyeHardness 不小心建在 Vector Parameters（向量參數）而不是 Scalar Parameters（純量參數）。向量參數在節點裡會顯示成紅色色塊，連到只接受單一數字的 Hardness 時，引擎會抓 R 通道的 1.0、判定成 100% 硬度，邊緣就完全被切齊。修法：把這兩個參數移到 Scalar Parameters 重建，並讓 EyeHardness 預設值接近 0，羽化就會回來。
Usually AmountOpened / EyeHardness were created under Vector Parameters instead of Scalar Parameters. A vector parameter shows as a red colour swatch in the graph; wired into Hardness (which expects a single number) the engine reads the R channel's 1.0 as 100% hardness, clipping the edge dead sharp. Fix: rebuild both as Scalar Parameters and set EyeHardness near 0 — the feathering returns.
